fix(admin): payouts manual joins, escrow read-only view, inline bank account form

- Rewrote /api/admin/payouts GET to use manual batch queries instead of
  PostgREST nested joins -- payment_requests has no FK constraints so
  the aliased join syntax returned nothing; now fetches agreements,
  profiles, bank accounts, and emails in parallel then merges them

- Repurposed admin escrow page as a read-only financial overview:
  removed the release-payment button, added status badges (Payment held /
  Awaiting approval / Awaiting payout), summary strip with total held and
  per-status counts, and expanded the API query to include paid_held and
  delivered agreements alongside completed ones; renamed nav tab to Funds

- Replaced the Go to Profile link in the consultant payment request modal
  with an inline bank account form -- consultants with no saved accounts
  can now add one without leaving the dashboard; on save the account is
  inserted, local state updated, and the selector shown immediately so
  the payment request can proceed in one flow

fix(admin): add disputes page so disputed agreements are visible to admin

Disputed agreements (status=disputed) were invisible in the admin panel
because the existing appeals page only queried status=appealed.

- Add /api/admin/disputes GET route fetching status=disputed agreements
  with student, consultant, and request details
- Add /api/admin/resolve-dispute POST route with email notifications
  to both parties and note that appeal is available
- Add /admin/disputes page with Rule for Student / Rule for Consultant
  actions and resolution notes field
- Add Disputes as first tab in admin nav before Appeals

feat(mainnet+bot): fresh mainnet proof under fixed contract, /importkey

Landing page FAQ now links a mainnet deploy + guarded spend performed
under the agent_pkh-fixed validator, replacing the links to the old
vulnerable contract's transactions from before the fix.

Telegram bot: added /importkey <privateKey> [perTxCap] [dailyCap] so
a user can register with a key they already control instead of only
being offered one the bot generates. The bot still signs on their
behalf during use - that part is unavoidable for a chat interface with
no wallet-extension access - but the user now always has their own
copy of the key from the start rather than depending on bot storage
for it. Best-effort deletes the message containing the raw key.

Merge pull request #4 from opa1/staging

Staging

refactor: remove claim/drop task actions, simplify submission flow

Eliminate the separate claim step from the task workflow. Users now submit work directly without a prior claim, and submissions are no longer reserved. Multiple users can submit for the same task until the poster approves one. Update UI components to reflect the new flow (remove `slotsRemaining`, add `submissionCount`) and adjust all tests accordingly.

feat: implement closeMission action with shared refund logic

Extract refund logic from processDeadlineRefund into a reusable function closeAndRefundUnfilled, used by both deadline cron and poster's manual close. Add tests for closeMission covering unfilled slots, partial approvals, rejection of submissions, and refund safety. This ensures consistent refund handling and prevents double refunds.
